P7r1: The Zapatistas are also the closest thing to a whole example that I found, because their autonomy goes beyond just how they vote. Education, health care, justice, collective production, political formation, ways of teaching outsiders: they've built their own versions of all of it, while coordinating beyond a single village.
P7r2: The Zapatistas are also the closest thing to a whole example that I found, because their autonomy goes beyond how they vote. They've set up their own education and health care, and their own justice, and they run their own collective production and political formation. On top of that they've worked out ways of teaching outsiders, all while coordinating beyond a single village.
P14z3: In celebration of the 10th anniversary of their autonomous governments, the Zapatistas opened up the Escuelita, where outsiders lived with families and learned autonomy by taking part in day to day life. Around 1,500 students came to the first sessions, and thousands more came to later ones.
